title: GTA 6 Lucia Actress Manni L. Perez Issues First Statement Since Launch
description: Manni L. Perez, the actress behind Lucia in GTA 6, has released her very first public statement since the game launched, capturing industry attention.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Lucia Actress Manni L. Perez Breaks Silence

Ever since the official release of Rockstar Games' massive open-world blockbuster *GTA 6*, the gaming community has been immersed in the vibrant streets of Leonida. As the first playable female protagonist in the history of the franchise, Lucia has instantly cemented herself as a cultural icon. Recently, IGN Games reported that Manni L. Perez, the talented actress who brings Lucia to life, has officially issued her first public statement since the game came out.

## The Journey of Bringing Lucia to Life

Rockstar Games is renowned for keeping its production details heavily under wraps, and the casting of its lead roles is always a tightly guarded secret. Long before the game hit shelves, the initial trailers gave players a glimpse of Lucia, sparking immense curiosity about the person behind the performance. Now that *GTA 6* is available to the public, players have been experiencing Lucia's compelling narrative firsthand, with Manni L. Perez's performance receiving widespread acclaim from fans and critics alike.

This newly issued statement marks a significant milestone following the game's historic launch. While the brief statement reported by IGN Games focuses on acknowledging the release rather than teasing future updates or expansions, it offers a wonderful moment of connection between the fanbase and the talent who defined one of gaming's most important characters.

## Editor's Take

Manni L. Perez stepping forward with her first post-launch statement is a welcome nod to the community. As *GTA 6* continues to break records and dominate the gaming landscape, hearing from the creative talents behind these iconic roles enriches the overall player experience.
